story: Garage loads the supplied blue A6; controls articulate its panels and axles and preserve wheel customization.
checks: Only the new versioned A6 is requested and rendered
All four door hinges, bonnet and tailgate respond independently
Keyboard sliders steer both front axles 30 degrees and rotate all four wheels 90 degrees
Reset closes all panels and restores neutral axles
Original A6 rims/calipers and alternative tyres remain configurable and persist after reload
390px and 320px phones can operate panels and all eight toolbar controls have 44px touch targets
